componentMapping.Four full-page bodies: src/main.js content() / surface(); About added directly in frontend after Work

assumptions: Original Figma captures contain three pages. User later requested About after Work: the frontend now has Home, Work, About, Contact at widths 100%, 90%, 80%, 70%. Original Figma captures remain unchanged historical references.

About was designed directly in the frontend with warm paper background, editable placeholder introduction, optional portrait, draggable stickers and Currently rows. No personal biography or interests were fabricated.
Figma exported SVG graphics remain independent assets; text and layout remain HTML/CSS.
Desktop follows 1440x900; mobile <=760px uses a vertical work list and vertical rail labels.
Native internal scrolling takes precedence on short or narrow screens; a fresh gesture at an edge changes page.
Sheet descent and reverse use 700ms; label expansion uses a 550ms reveal from the rail. Reduced motion is instantaneous.
A 180ms idle gap separates wheel gestures; events during a transition do not queue another transition.
Expanded pages keep all four page labels. Scrolling continues to the adjacent page's stacked state.

Project cards open a native modal image preview as requested in the frontend follow-up. The preview uses the full-size asset, or optional previewAsset; no extra website route is added. Contact email is unset until supplied.
No simulated system bars exist in the source. No system nodes were excluded. Browser dynamic viewport units own the page height.
Inter is served locally through @fontsource/inter; browser and Figma glyph metrics can differ slightly.

captureReview.note: Two CLI launches failed from temporary host memory exhaustion before a capture directory was created. Processes were confirmed ended and Bridge was read back before fresh captures. No Figma mutations or automatic replay occurred.

frontendFork.change: Move header page labels and exposed rails to the left; anchor sheets to the right; reveal expanded pages from the left.
